info.title: fsclean - find dead code, and unneeded project references, in F# projects
info.description: Finds and removes dead code, and unneeded project references, in F# projects.

options.name: --whole-program
options.description:
Treat only entry points as roots, even in libraries. Use when every
consumer of a library is among the projects given.

options.name: --explain
options.description:
Also explain each declaration whose name contains <text>: what uses it,
what it uses, and what keeps it alive.

options.name: --references
options.description:
List every project reference with the uses behind it, not only the ones
with no compile-time use.

options.name: --fix
options.description:
Remove the dead code from the source files. Each removal is checked: it only
stays if the projects still type-check. Commit first, so it can be reviewed
with git diff.

options.name: --help
options.description:
Show this help.
The projects must be restored first (dotnet restore).
